description: Get the favicon (square icon) of a company by domain. Returns the scalable SVG URL and a PNG URL at the nearest standard size (128, 256, 512 or 1024). If the brand is not in the catalog, found is false.

domain.description: Company domain, for example stripe.com. A URL or www. prefix is accepted.

size.description: Wanted size in pixels. The PNG snaps to 128, 256, 512 or 1024.

name: get_favicon
title: Get a company favicon
